documented_probe: Covering task for C-92072676 (connect to a postgres service using compose-provided credentials) at medium difficulty; verifier fully checks the capability on hidden stack/database scenarios.
notes: Single-stage: parse a compose-style stack file (mapping or list-style environment, decoy non-postgres service), derive host port from the published mapping (non-default port, scram enforced on TCP so wrong passwords fail), connect with the file-provided credentials, and census the beacons table into an exact JSON audit. A decoy second instance shares the visible database name/credentials with an EMPTY table, so a wrong port still connects but reads nothing. Hidden scenarios vary service name, credentials, database, data, and instance; include a list-style environment, an empty registry (strongest=null), a strength tie broken by lowest id, and two expect-failure stacks (wrong password, unreachable port) that must exit non-zero without creating the output file. Distinct from quartz-cipher/granary-ledge in scenario (beacon survey), decoy-instance trap, and expect-failure mechanics.
